description: Durable memory that maintains itself. Each turn, Jev (the rlcd service) picks which notes and skills fit what is happening, by asking each entry its own when_to_retrieve questions, and at the end of each turn the agent is asked whether anything is worth writing down. Everything is ordinary markdown in your workspace — notes in memory/notes/, agentskills.io skills in memory/skills/ — so you can read and edit it yourself. Needs a TypeSafe API key for rlcd; nothing is indexed and no embedding model is installed.
name: Memory
